title: Navigation and outdoor skills
learning_outcomes: Explain maps and scale in the context of navigation and outdoor skills.
Compare and distinguish weather and terrain in the context of navigation and outdoor skills.
Apply communication and turnaround in the context of navigation and outdoor skills.
Evaluate and justify decisions about local advice in the context of navigation and outdoor skills.

lessons.title: Maps and scale
lessons.outcome: Explain maps and scale in the context of navigation and outdoor skills.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving maps and scale; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to dry-land route plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain maps and scale from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of maps and scale; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Weather and terrain
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish weather and terrain in the context of navigation and outdoor skills.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving weather and terrain; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to dry-land route plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain weather and terrain from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of weather and terrain; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Communication and turnaround
lessons.outcome: Apply communication and turnaround in the context of navigation and outdoor skills.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving communication and turnaround; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to dry-land route plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain communication and turnaround from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of communication and turnaround; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Local advice
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about local advice in the context of navigation and outdoor skills.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving local advice; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to dry-land route plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain local advice from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of local advice; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of maps and scale; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of weather and terrain; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of communication and turnaround; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of local advice; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
